# Conan revisions

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/conan.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **Conan 2.33.0 primary; Conan 1.66.0 legacy**. Registered classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/artifactory/api/conan/${AW_REPO}`

## Before connecting

- A Conan 2 conanfile.py and the compiler/build tools required by its recipe.
- For Conan 1, use a separate installation and home; enable revisions.

Authentication: Use AW_USER and a short-lived AW_TOKEN whose subject is AW_USER. The server accepts an access/reference token as the Basic password and rechecks the subject and repository permissions. Reading requires read permission; publication requires write permission and replacement may require delete permission.

Fresh client state: Run in a disposable client container with a new /work mount, or a new temporary project directory with all the client home/cache paths below. The acceptance harness uses a new scenario directory and container. Never reuse your normal client home for this check.

## Configure

Conan 2 commands. Conan 1 uses conan user "$AW_USER" -p "$AW_TOKEN" -r aw and an explicit Conan 1 profile.

```sh
export CONAN_HOME="$(mktemp -d)"
export CONAN_USER_HOME="$CONAN_HOME"
export CONAN_REVISIONS_ENABLED=1
conan remote add aw "$AW_URL/artifactory/api/conan/$AW_REPO"
conan remote login aw "$AW_USER" -p "$AW_TOKEN"
conan profile detect --force
```

## Publish

Classes: **local, virtual, federated**. Publish only to the classes listed here. A federated recipe proves one-node behavior; remote repositories are read-only client sources.

Use your package reference. Conan 1 uses its user/channel reference and upload --all -c.

```sh
conan create .
conan upload hello/1.0 -r aw -c
```

## Install or resolve

Classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**. Use the selected repository key. Virtual resolution requires readable configured members; remote resolution requires an administrator-configured upstream.

Run from a second fresh CONAN_HOME after adding/logging into aw there, so producer cache contents cannot satisfy this fetch.

```sh
conan download hello/1.0 -r aw
```

## Limits

Classes outside **local, remote, virtual, federated** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- Virtual publication is supported only when its defaultDeploymentRepo is an allowed local member; select that configuration before using V.
- The legacy Conan 1 lane requires revisions; its reference and profile syntax differ from Conan 2.
